_note: Narration, one entry per scene. Edit text here, then run: python ../tts/generate.py. Scene lengths follow the voice. hold_after = extra seconds of picture after a scene's voice (the silent real-time fall).

scenes.text: This is a snap shackle. Sailors use it to drop a line with one tug.
On May 23rd, 1999, one of these was the only thing holding wrestler Owen Hart above the ring.
The stunt: lower him from the rafters, then release just above the mat, as a comedy fall.
Instead, near the roof, it opened.
There was no backup line. He fell seventy-eight feet in about two seconds, reaching nearly fifty miles an hour.
He hit the top rope chest first, a foot from the turnbuckle. The impact severed his aorta.
He was pronounced dead at 8:12 PM. He was thirty-four. The show went on.
A life-safety rig uses rated hardware, two independent lines, and no quick release on the load.
No single part should ever hold a life alone.
